user.title: Spot prices
user.description: Choose the sensor(s) with spot prices in 15-minute intervals (e.g. OKTE integration). Today is required, tomorrow is optional.

data_description.price_today: Sensor whose attributes contain the price list (e.g. period_data).
data_description.price_tomorrow: Usually published around 14:00 for the next day.

tarifa.title: Purchase tariff
tarifa.description: Low tariff (NT) hours and purchase prices including distribution. Defaults match ZSE DD3 for EV owners.

data_description.nt_intervals: Format HH:MM-HH:MM separated by comma, e.g. 23:45-05:45, 13:45-15:45
data_description.sell_fee: Amount your buyer deducts from the spot price when you sell.

bateria.title: Battery and PV
bateria.description: Describe your battery. PV forecast is optional – without it the plan only uses the grid.

data_description.soc_entity: Sensor with battery state of charge in %.
data_description.charge_kw: Power at which the inverter charges the battery from the grid.
data_description.export_kw: Power at which the inverter exports from the battery.
data_description.house_kw: Used in the plan to estimate consumption.
data_description.pv_power_entity: Optional – refines the PV-only selling decision.

auto.title: EV charging
auto.description:
Optional – if you have no EV, leave **Charging switch** empty.

For a *select* switch fill in the options for charging and off (SmartEVSE is filled automatically: Normal / Off).{options}

data_description.ev_switch_entity: switch, input_boolean or select of the charger (e.g. select.smartevse_mode).
data_description.ev_current_entity: number with current in A. Without it the charger is only switched on/off.
data_description.ev_charging_entity: Optional – e.g. sensor.smartevse_state (Charging). Needed to detect a full battery in the Start time mode.
data_description.ev_power_entity: Optional – more precise than the estimate from current.
data_description.grid_power_entity: Optional but recommended – power at the main meter. Used for PV surplus and breaker protection.
data_description.grid_invert: Enable if your sensor shows grid import as a negative value.
data_description.grid_limit_kw: Total grid import will stay below this value (e.g. 14.5). 0 = no limit.
data_description.cable_kw: If battery and wallbox share one cable/breaker (e.g. 12). Battery has priority. 0 = no limit.

error.no_prices: No prices found in this sensor's attributes.
error.invalid_intervals: Invalid hours – use HH:MM-HH:MM separated by comma.
error.ev_min_max: Minimum current is higher than maximum.
error.ev_option: Enter an option the select knows: {options}
